=== Add multiple WKT geometries to a layer

[source,cypher]
----
CALL spatial.addLayer('geom','geohash','lon:lat')
----

[source,cypher]
----
CALL spatial.addWKTs('geom',[ "POINT (15.2 60.1)", "POINT (25.2 30.1)" ])
